properties.name: Columbia Basin
properties.derivation: Selected GMBA broad basic ranges, plus retained historical footprint/approach neighborhoods where present, clipped to the existing complete statewide start footprint; remaining locations allocated by EPA ecoregions and the documented shoreline/state-edge repair. No mountain, elevation or terrain threshold determines eligibility.

gmba.dataset: GMBA Mountain Inventory v2.0, broad extent, basic non-overlapping ranges
gmba.datasetCitation: Snethlage et al. (2022), GMBA Mountain Inventory v2, https://doi.org/10.48601/earthenv-t9k2-1407
gmba.publicationCitation: Snethlage et al. (2022), A hierarchical inventory of the world’s mountains for global comparative mountain science, Scientific Data, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-022-01256-y
gmba.limitation: Broad extent includes surrounding landscape and support polygons. Used to organize eligible starts, not to classify every included location as mountainous.

epa.derivation: Source NAD83 Albers Equal Area polygons transformed to WGS84 EPSG:4326 with pyshp 3.1.6 and pyproj 3.8.0; used only to allocate residual statewide coverage after the selected GMBA ranges and historical footprints.

properties.name: Washington eligible-start coverage obligation
properties.basis: Union of all twelve Washington effective start footprints at 8e95bc3, including the pinned Census 2025 statewide county inventory and retained historical footprints and approach neighborhoods. Used only as a gap-regression baseline; county assignments are superseded.
properties.license: U.S. Census Bureau public domain; retained OpenStreetMap-derived boundaries ODbL 1.0; USDA Forest Service public domain. Original attribution retained in Git history.

edgeRepair.method: For each connected remaining part outside the EPA polygons, assign its representative point to the nearest post-EPA group by GEOS distance in EPSG:5070; tie-break by ascending region ID.

properties.limitation: The source boundaries are geographic groupings with scale and vintage limitations, not legal access boundaries or proof that all trails are mapped. US-only limits and explicit exclusions still apply. Build costs and representative routes require a real-data build.

authoringPrecision.method: GEOS buffer of valid raw derived geometry by 3e-7 degrees with mitre joins and mitre_limit=2, then topology-preserving valid-output set_precision on a shared 1e-7-degree grid. No runtime normalization.
authoringPrecision.hashEncoding: UTF-8 JSON geometry, compact comma/colon separators; numeric serialization from Python 3 json.dumps.
